title: Noren
description: A noren curtain as a section divider: three hanging panels that sway, and part when you reach for them.
usage: Shops hang a noren to say "open, and someone is home" — as a divider it marks a threshold between sections of a page: the catalog above, the story below. The panels sway on staggered clocks (transform-origin at the bar, a degree and a bit each way), and part a few pixels on hover, the way a hand brushes cloth. The crest on the middle panel is the mold glyph; swap in your own mark.
a11y: A divider is a picture of a doorway: it carries an aria-label if it must say anything, and the heading structure of the page does the real work of separating sections. The sway is transform-only and stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
